classification: TASK-009 quick-fix 2 candidate: slice157 all-entries VU1 table; GT4_FORCE_480P=1 rewrites the guest CRT mode table (row id 1 and fallback row 8) to 480p progressive after the ELF is loaded. Not owner-measured.
preserved_inputs: Production EE library, donor 1b48087 runtime capsule with the VU1 AOT overlay (private/slice155-vu1-full-runtime, receipt identical to slice154), slice153 pacing adapter and nine shaders reused byte-identical from private/slice153-pacing-port and private/slice153-pacing-shaders; slice151-154 build directories untouched.

controls.ctest: CTest 20/20 on private/slice158-quickfix2-build/build (includes native_display_table and native_pacing; late_frames fixture with the 1 ms tolerance).
controls.python: unittest discover with GT4_NATIVE_BUILD on the slice158 build: 251 OK, 1 skipped (pre-existing).
controls.headless_frames: Headless 4,200 frames, 12 presses (600:start:30 then cross/start/down every 300 frames to 3900:start:30), no window: 42 frame dumps identical to the slice157 build (control-157, same schedule and environment) with GT4_FORCE_480P unset.
controls.headless_480p: GT4_FORCE_480P=1: the log has the table line "[display] GT4_FORCE_480P=1: CRT table rows id 1 and fallback set to interlace 0 mode 0x50 field 1", but the only SetGsCrt line is still "interlace 1 mode 0x2 field 1"; the 42 frame dumps are identical to the unset run (0 differ).

limits: GT4_FORCE_480P=1 does not change the SetGsCrt request that the headless boot issues (interlace 1 mode 0x2 field 1). The CRT table rows are rewritten in guest RAM, but that request is produced by a path that does not read the table. 480p is NOT achieved by this build; do not present it as 480p.
The table rewrite also changes the fallback row, so any unlisted CRT request also resolves to 480p while the switch is on (the fallback row was 480i).
The slice156 SetGsCrt rewrite is not part of this capsule (no hw.cpp).
Owner gameplay, frame timing and presentation are not measured. The window path (half-height lines) was not run.
The pinned SCUS_973.28 ELF rows at 0x618648 were read from private/reconstructed; the native fixture checks the same bytes, the runtime check refuses other values.

review.note: Owner gameplay and frame timing not run; local CTest, Python, headless frame and verify evidence only.
